findings.title: Cross-Section Referral Modification via IDOR
findings.description: Authenticated users can submit PUT requests to /referrals/{document} or /referrals/section/{document} and update referrals belonging to any section without authorization checks.

findings.title: Race Condition in Tracking Number Sequence Generation
findings.description: Document::max('document_id') + 1 allows phantom reads during concurrent document registrations, generating identical tracking numbers and throwing unhandled SQL exceptions.

findings.title: Session Persistence for Deactivated Employees
findings.description: Deactivating an employee account in the database does not destroy the user's active session or tokens, permitting continued system operations.

findings.title: Missing Session Invalidation on Password Update
findings.description: Updating credentials does not invalidate concurrent sessions on other devices using Auth::logoutOtherDevices().

findings.title: Avatar Upload Decompression Bomb Vulnerability
findings.description: Avatar storage checks file byte size but does not limit image pixel dimensions before calling GD imagecreatefromstring, leading to PHP memory exhaustion.

findings.title: Insecure Cookie Flag Defaults
findings.description: SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE defaults to null, failing to enforce HTTPS-only cookies unless explicitly specified in environment config.

findings.title: Over-permissive $fillable on Document Model
findings.description: Attributes like status_id, current_employee_id, and deletion_approved_by are mass-assignable on the Document model.

findings.title: Absence of Granular Rate Limiting on Document Registration
findings.description: Document creation and referral submission routes have no specific throttle limits, leaving endpoints vulnerable to automated flooding.

findings.title: Session Driver Configured to Single-Node Local File Storage
findings.description: File session store cannot be shared across multiple web workers or load balancers, causing session stickiness failure.

findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP) Headers
findings.description: Application does not emit standard Content-Security-Policy or X-Content-Type-Options headers in HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing Validation on Section Referral Deletion Request Cancellation
findings.description: Request deletion flag can be updated without validating if the document is in a transit state.

findings.title: Document Comments Remarks Input Size Limit
findings.description: Remarks accept text without explicit maximum character validation on certain internal routes.

findings.title: Outdated Minor Dependencies in package.json
findings.description: Minor version updates available for Vite plugins and Tailwind utilities with no known direct CVEs.

findings.title: Database Seeders with Static Demo Data
findings.description: Seeders contain static mock accounts that should strictly be blocked from executing in production environments.
